In nineteen seventy-five, a man got rich selling rocks. As pets.
It started in a California bar. His friends were complaining about their pets. The feeding. The mess.
So he joked that the perfect pet was a rock.
He bought smooth stones from a Mexican beach, for a penny each.
Each one came in a cardboard pet carrier, with straw, and air holes to breathe.
Plus a training manual. "Sit" and "stay" were easy. "Roll over" needed a little help.
By Christmas, over a million had sold. He named his company Rock Bottom Productions.
Luckily, it made him a millionaire.
Unluckily, by February, his pets were on sale.
A million people paid for a friend who can't do anything.
Because sometimes, you just want something that's yours.
A rock will never leave you. It will never say good morning, either.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny listens, remembers your day, and actually talks back.
